name: Chilion
bio: Chilion is Naomi and Elimelech's other son, traditionally understood to be Orpah's husband, though the text does not state this directly. Like his father and brother, he dies in Moab before the story's main events begin. His death, alongside his father's and brother's, is what leaves Naomi without a husband or sons and sets up her decision to return to Bethlehem.
